thesis: The page is the odometer: each section is a mileage row that rolls to its interval, and the signature is the digit roll that distinguishes due now from not yet.

signature.name: Service-Interval Odometer Rows
signature.summary: Horizontal tabular-digit row with status pill and service label; wipes in on scroll via --sw-p clip-path. Reused in hero tool output, service cards, review mileage pills, and footer reminder row.

palette.family: Desert Dash + Cool Blue + Signal Orange

motion.intro: Odometer digits roll 000000→045000; three result rows slide up in 60ms stagger; skippable via sw-motion class.
stories: Service odo-row clip-path wipe left-to-right on entry
Review mileage pill count-up on entry
motion.hover: Hairline underline scaleX 0→1 from left on links and buttons
